question.worked_solution:
We proceed by setting the lower bound equal to some parameter $a,$ integrating as usual, and then taking the limit as $a\to -\infty .$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-\infty }^{-1}\frac{35}{{x}^{8}}\,\text{d}x & =35{lim}_{a\to -\infty }{\int }_{a}^{-1}{x}^{-8}\,\text{d}x \\  & =35{lim}_{a\to -\infty }{[-\frac{1}{7}{x}^{-7}]}_{a}^{-1} \\  & =-5\cdot {lim}_{a\to -\infty }{[\frac{1}{{x}^{7}}]}_{a}^{-1} \\  & =-5\cdot {lim}_{a\to -\infty }[\frac{1}{(-1)^{7}}-\frac{1}{{a}^{7}}] \\  & =-5\cdot (-1-0) \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
